digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable ticket-event history must be reclaimed from the tickets branch via history rewrite and gc/repack to bring the filtered pack below the 131,072 KiB CI verification gate limit
The git-fast-export/filter/fast-import history strip must preserve exact tree/commit/merge counts, exclude .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ residual history, and result in a fresh clone under 150 MiB
Prerequisite bug-fix ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must complete with zero repairable diagnostics and exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records before history rewrite begins

Identity verification must pass pre/post with identical event counts, matching (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets, and mapped rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pinned through Gerrit review

All writers must remain paused throughout the maintenance window; the deterministic first post-rewrite commit must be the review-bot re-pin vote with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled and its prior setting restored
Publication must use exact --force-with-lease with verified off-repo bundles at both pre-repair and pre-rewrite checkpoints, and the rewritten tip must not retain old-tip ancestry in any fetched ref
